style: photoreal 3D macro, deadpan satire, one take

subject.character: a praying mantis, slender green-brown, triangular head, huge amber eyes, folded raptorial arms, on a dry stem. The head turns on a still body. Same mantis in both scenes
subject.anti_action: he smooths the crumpled price tag flat and re-hangs it on the stem like a shop display, in earnest

cast: a fat fly with a tiny foam mic, ALWAYS huge at the lens, nearer than the mantis, never in background, never speaks
props: one paper price tag on the stem, one foam mic in the fly's legs. The scrawled price is the only text, a real prop not an overlay
environment: a dry grey stem from a crack in concrete, an empty warm evening yard blurred behind, a long shadow falling in from the left
lighting: warm amber rim from the right, cool cyan bounce from the left off the concrete, long shadow from the left, high contrast

light_events.event: the shadow from the left grows longer

voice: male, low warm chest voice around 130 Hz, dry, weary, deadpan, unhurried, same voice in both scenes
lip_sync: he talks like a person: mouthparts open and close clearly on every syllable; the voice is his own, never a voice over

audio.delivery: unhurried, weary deadpan, native Russian, no accent, normal conversational tempo
audio.pacing: normal even tempo, no rushing, each line ends inside its beat, nothing after 5.25

speech_rule: while he speaks he touches nothing: only the mouth works and the camera moves. Anything moving then is the fly or the wind

timeline.a: silent. Head snaps 180 degrees to the lens, body frozen; the fly lunges the mic in
speaking at normal tempo, speaking only; the fly shoves the mic at his mouth
silent. One arm crushes the tag into a ball, which drops and wedges in the fork of the stem and stays there
speaking at normal tempo, speaking only; the fly hovers back, wings blurring the lens
silent. His body sways once like a leaf
speaking at normal tempo, speaking only; the fly bobs at the lens
silent. He re-grips the stem, head tilting down
speaking at normal tempo, speaking only; the fly freezes and lowers the mic
silent from here on. Arms fold in prayer and snap out at empty air with a dry click
the fly lands on his head, the mic knocking against his jaws
he lifts the crumpled ball out of the fork of the stem
he smooths it flat against the stem
he hangs it back on the stem like a shop display
the shadow slides over the stem, the tip of a second pair of folded arms enters at the left edge

negative_prompt: slow speech, drawn-out delivery, touching props while speaking, speech after 5.3, voice over, motionless mouth, subtitles, burned-in captions, subtitle bars, watermark, UI text, English speech, foreign accent, static camera, locked-off shots, cuts, jump cuts, floating objects, duplicate props, a second tag or mic, a second mantis fully visible in frame, a whole second body, any insect other than the mantis and the one fly, the fly speaking or in background, appearance changing mid-shot
